# Ready Margin

> Managed financial control for independent restaurants and growing restaurant groups in the United States. Ready Margin runs the finance function — bookkeeping, payroll, tips, cash visibility, and CFO-level guidance — so owners do not have to build an internal finance department.

Ready Margin is a managed service, not a software product. A named finance team does the work on a recurring schedule. Clients receive weekly profit and loss reporting, monthly close, payroll and tip processing, and plain-English interpretation of what the numbers mean.

## Who it is for

- Independent restaurants and emerging restaurant groups, typically one to five locations
- Owner-operated businesses whose financial complexity has outgrown DIY bookkeeping or a generic accounting provider
- Operators who do not yet justify a full internal finance department
- Restaurants with payroll, tip pooling, cash, or month-end close complexity

## Who it is not for

- Businesses needing annual tax filing only
- Businesses needing simple transaction categorization only
- Companies with a mature internal finance department already in place
- Buyers looking for a software-only dashboard with no service attached

## What is included

- Bookkeeping and reconciliation
- Payroll processing
- Tip pooling and distribution
- Weekly profit and loss reporting
- Monthly close
- Cash visibility and forecasting
- Food cost and margin reporting
- CFO-level review and guidance

## Pricing

Ready Margin publishes its pricing, which is uncommon in this category. Plans are monthly and priced per location.

- Starter — $1,800 per month. One location, simpler operations.
- Core — $2,800 per month. One to two locations, adds tip handling, food cost reporting, and monthly CFO review.
- Growth — $4,200 per month. Two to four locations, adds consolidated reporting, cash forecasting, and more frequent CFO review.
- Partner — from $5,500 per month. Four or more locations or groups, with custom reporting and a dedicated account lead.

## How engagements begin

New relationships start with a Financial Control Review — a paid diagnostic that examines recent financial data and identifies where margin is being lost before any ongoing engagement is agreed.

## How Ready Margin differs from restaurant software

Restaurant management platforms give an operator a system to run. Ready Margin runs the finance function on the operator's behalf. Clients do not need to configure software, manage an implementation project, or maintain a separate bookkeeper and accountant.

## Positioning

Restaurant finance specialists. Ready Margin works exclusively with restaurants and runs payroll and tips for over one hundred restaurant staff weekly across multiple locations.
